name: Enhanced Delivery* (Ex)
body:
Benefit(s): Whenever a rogue with this talent uses a poisoned weapon to attempt an attack in conjunction with a sneak attack, the DC to resist the poison increases by half her number of sneak attack dice (minimum 1).
